name: Braille Charm
description: A small charm, pendant, or zipper pull carrying one or two braille cells. Type a character or two and the translation to Unicode braille runs entirely on your device via liblouis. Every shape exports already oriented for printing: pendants lean back at 75 degrees on a flat contact strip with a slim break-away support fin (or print flat), and the bracelet_clip C-clip stands vertically with no supports at all.
author: OpenSCAD Assistive Forge contributors

inspired_by.name: Nasif Zaman (charm base), Duy Do / UW WOOF3D (bracelet clip), and Brennen Johnston (braille dot system)
